title: Microsoft targets multi-gigawatt scale for Maia 300
summary: Microsoft says its Maia 300 inference system will reach multi-gigawatt deployments in 2027, challenging Nvidia’s role in its largest AI workloads.
body:
Microsoft has announced Maia 300, the next generation of its in-house AI accelerator, and said it plans to scale the Azure Maia family to multi-gigawatt deployments beginning in 2027. The announcement turns a custom-chip program into a central part of Microsoft’s infrastructure strategy rather than a limited experiment.

## Designed around inference

Microsoft describes Maia 300 as an inference-first system for long-context reasoning, latency-sensitive conversations and sustained agentic workloads. A full rack is planned to combine 96 accelerators within a 167-kilowatt power envelope, with 27.6 terabytes of HBM capacity and 1.7 petabytes per second of aggregate HBM bandwidth.

The company claims Maia 300 will deliver 40% more tokens per megawatt than leading GPU-based systems and up to seven times the rack-scale token throughput of Maia 200. Maia 200 is already serving Microsoft production workloads, including Copilot, while later deployments are expected to support GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Foundry and Dragon Copilot.

Microsoft’s design emphasizes data movement and memory efficiency as much as raw compute. The chip uses HBM4, a multi-chiplet architecture and lower-precision formats intended to reduce bandwidth and power requirements for large models and long context windows. Microsoft says Maia 300 will begin production deployments in 2027.

## What changes for the market

The announcement does not mean Microsoft is abandoning Nvidia. Azure will continue to offer a broad mixture of hardware, and the Maia system is being built for Microsoft’s own workloads. But the scale is strategically meaningful: multi-gigawatt deployment gives Microsoft a way to optimize cost, power and software behavior around its own services instead of accepting every constraint of general-purpose GPU infrastructure.

The open question is execution. Maia 300 is still a future production system, and Microsoft’s performance-per-watt comparisons are company claims rather than independent benchmarks. Even so, the plan signals that custom inference silicon is moving from a defensive procurement tactic to a core competitive layer for hyperscalers running agents at global volume.
title_zh: 微软计划2027年将Maia 300扩至多吉瓦规模
summary_zh: 微软公布Maia 300推理系统，计划从2027年起部署多吉瓦规模，云厂商自研芯片对英伟达的替代压力进一步上升。
body_zh:
微软公布Maia 300新一代自研AI加速器，并表示将从2027年起把Azure Maia家族扩展到多吉瓦部署。自研芯片由此不再只是微软的补充方案，而成为其AI基础设施战略的核心组成部分。

## 为推理负载重新设计

微软称，Maia 300采用推理优先架构，面向长上下文推理、低延迟对话和持续运行的智能体任务。完整机架将搭载96颗加速器，功耗上限为167千瓦，提供27.6TB HBM容量和每秒1.7PB的总HBM带宽。

微软宣称，Maia 300每兆瓦可处理的Token数量比主流GPU系统高40%，机架级Token吞吐量最高达到Maia 200的7倍。Maia 200已经服务Copilot等微软生产业务，后续还将用于GitHub Copilot、Microsoft Foundry和Dragon Copilot。

Maia 300的重点不仅是计算能力，也包括数据搬运和内存效率。系统采用HBM4、多芯粒设计以及低精度格式，以降低大模型和长上下文任务的带宽与功耗需求。微软预计该系统将在2027年开始生产部署。

## 对产业意味着什么

这并不意味着微软会放弃英伟达。Azure仍会提供多种硬件，而Maia主要针对微软自有业务进行优化。但多吉瓦部署规模意味着，微软可以围绕自家服务共同设计芯片、软件和数据中心，不必完全接受通用GPU基础设施的成本和功耗约束。

真正的考验仍是交付。Maia 300尚未进入生产，性能功耗对比也主要来自微软自身数据，并非独立测试。即便如此，这项计划已经释放出明确信号：对于需要全球规模运行智能体的云厂商，自研推理芯片正在从采购策略升级为竞争壁垒。

cat_take_zh: Maia 300最重要的数字不是7倍吞吐，而是微软敢把推理芯片押到多吉瓦
cat_take_en: The consequential number is not sevenfold throughput; it is Microsoft committing its own inference silicon at multi-gigawatt scale.
